parameters.query:
WITH cursor_execution AS (
  SELECT id, created_at
  FROM executions
  WHERE id::text = $2::text
), selected_executions AS (
  SELECT e.id,
         e.created_at,
         e.flow_type,
         e.status,
         e.duration_ms,
         e.cache_hit,
         e.source_execution_id,
         t.execution_id AS telemetry_execution_id,
         t.provider,
         t.model_requested,
         t.model_used,
         t.prompt_tokens,
         t.completion_tokens,
         t.total_tokens,
         t.cost_usd,
         t.input_cost_usd,
         t.output_cost_usd,
         t.cache_read_tokens
  FROM executions e
  LEFT JOIN execution_telemetry t ON t.execution_id = e.id
  WHERE ($2::text IS NULL OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM cursor_execution cursor_row
           WHERE e.created_at < cursor_row.created_at
              OR (e.created_at = cursor_row.created_at AND e.id::text < cursor_row.id::text)
        ))
    AND ($3::text IS NULL OR e.flow_type = $3::text)
    AND ($4::text IS NULL OR e.status = $4::text)
    AND ($5::text IS NULL OR t.model_requested = $5::text)
    AND ($6::timestamptz IS NULL OR e.created_at >= $6::timestamptz)
    AND ($7::timestamptz IS NULL OR e.created_at <= $7::timestamptz)
    AND ($8::boolean IS NULL OR e.cache_hit = $8::boolean)
  ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
  LIMIT $1::integer
), records AS (
  SELECT e.id,
         e.created_at,
         jsonb_build_object(
           'id', e.id::text,
           'type', e.flow_type,
           'status', e.status,
           'timestamp', e.created_at,
           'duration_ms', e.duration_ms,
           'cache_hit', e.cache_hit,
           'source_execution_id', e.source_execution_id::text,
           'telemetry', CASE WHEN e.telemetry_execution_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object(
             'provider', e.provider,
             'model_requested', e.model_requested,
             'model_used', e.model_used,
             'openrouter_generation_id', NULL,
             'prompt_tokens', e.prompt_tokens,
             'completion_tokens', e.completion_tokens,
             'total_tokens', e.total_tokens,
             'cost_total_usd', e.cost_usd,
             'cost_input_usd', e.input_cost_usd,
             'cost_output_usd', e.output_cost_usd,
             'cache_read_tokens', e.cache_read_tokens
           ) END,
           'steps', COALESCE((
             SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
               'node_name', step.node_name,
               'kind', step.kind,
               'status', step.status,
               'duration_ms', step.duration_ms
             ) ORDER BY step.created_at ASC)
             FROM execution_steps step
             WHERE step.execution_id = e.id
           ), '[]'::jsonb)
         ) AS item
  FROM selected_executions e
)
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
FROM records;
